_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: score inside 32-38 Denial band, no single breaker, so statistically honest call is hold the rung until funding/Fear&Greed or volume breaks the range.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Denial; narrative silent on phase/direction and only paints cross-asset flow (oil/S&P down, metals up)
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score holds 32-38, BTC range-bound, funding near flat, no range-breaking volume
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear&Greed <25 with funding negative on a fast down-day (Panic) OR Fear&Greed >46 with ETF flows positive (Anxiety)
